description:
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {R}.
Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary, Ganax and Liliana trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shivan Devastator on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Shivan Devastator.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
